name: Tristian Henderson
strengths: Henderson explodes off the ball with real first-step burst to threaten the tackle’s outside shoulder.
Henderson shows bend to flatten the arc and chase the QB when the pocket collapses.
Henderson stays disciplined in run fit and does not abandon the edge when flow comes his way.
weaknesses: Henderson (6-4 / 217) still needs mass to hold up as an every-down SEC edge versus power tackles.
comparison: Henderson comps to Nik Bonitto — lean 6-4 EDGE who wins with first-step burst and bend before the frame fills into every-down mass.
projection: Henderson projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at JACK/EDGE (package rushes Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC edge rusher — the explosive bend rusher who can grow into every-down mass without losing the first step.
schemeFit: Henderson fits a bend-and-burst EDGE/JACK in White’s 3-3-5 who can rush standing up and still set the edge as he fills out.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-04 from On3 profile Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Tristian Henderson is a 4-star EDGE · listed 6-4 / 217 · Pine Forest (Pensacola, FL) (FL) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with Pensacola soph Hudl burst/bend, then mass-add note as the only brake.
insiderNotes: Henderson is a lean 6-4 EDGE who explodes off the ball with first-step burst, shows bend to flatten the arc, and stays disciplined when the pocket collapses. Wins with burst and bend before the frame fills — a JACK/EDGE mold with every-down upside as he adds mass.
